Free tools for your yard and garden, built by soil scientists. Work out how much material you actually need, check a quote before you pay it, and make decisions with the working shown.

No ads, no sign-up, and no supplier pays to be listed. Every tool shows how its numbers are calculated, so you can check them yourself.

## Calculators

::: {.cards}
::: {.card-item}
### [Landscape materials calculator](materials-calculator.qmd)
How much topsoil, compost, mulch, gravel, road base, sand, sod or grass seed to order, for any shape of yard. Cubic yards, tons, bags and pallets, with a bulk-vs-bags price check.
:::
::: {.card-item}
### Quote checker *(coming soon)*
Enter a quote and your area to see the depth and price per unit you're actually paying for.
:::
:::
